title: Basic Comforts
description: Simple mod for servers to have a world boarder without really having a world boarder. Also has some QOL recipes.
body:
Basic minecraft mod that limits the main area by scaling difficulty with distance from spawn. After around 2000 blocks out from spawn -- the mobs will be unsurvivable. Some new enchantments as well, most are obtained by normal enchanting, but some are only found by killing mobs over 1000 blocks away from spawn. 

More than 500 Blocks = Difficulty Changes Starting. 

More than 1000 Blocks = Mobs Start Dropping Extremely Powerful Items. Instant kills full netherite.

More than 2000 Blocks = Mobs now drop every powerful item possible allways.
